emailTemplates.subject: Thank You for Connecting with PIGL at NAPE 2026 😊
emailTemplates.bodyHtml:
PIGL

POLARIS INTEGRATED & GEOSOLUTIONS LIMITED

Dear {{first_name}},

Thank You for Visiting PIGL at NAPE 2026

Thank you for taking the time to visit the Polaris Integrated & GeoSolutions Limited (PIGL) booth at NAPE 2026.

It was a pleasure meeting you, learning about your interests and having the opportunity to introduce you to our capabilities across geoscience and engineering, metocean and marine services, integrated construction, and industrial solutions.

We value the connections made during the event and appreciate your interest in PIGL. We look forward to continuing the conversation and exploring opportunities to work together.

Should you require further information about our services or wish to discuss a potential project or collaboration, our team will be pleased to hear from you.

Thank you once again for visiting us. We look forward to staying connected.

Kind regards,

Polaris Integrated & GeoSolutions Limited (PIGL)
